sources.note: Avid Pro Tools | HDX product page (opened): HDX card with two DigiLink ports (64 channels) and one DigiSerial port; no dimensions.  PORT POSITIONS (both, confidence 'guess' since 2026-11-10): the box is a role-based workstation stand-in with no real panel; the DigiLink and the power inlet are placed at plausible positions on its rear plate. No source gives coordinates for them (searched again on 2026-11-10: Avid documents only the PCIe card, whose DigiLink Mini ports are on the card bracket, not on a workstation panel).

Pro Tools | HDX Getting Started guide (downloaded to a scratch folder outside the repo, text read): HDX PCIe card = 2 DigiLink Mini ports + 1 DigiSerial (8-pin mini-DIN), needs a full-length slot; installs in any qualified Mac/Windows workstation. No card or bracket dimensions, no workstation dimensions: the box is a role-based stand-in (see notes).
